diagnosis: Germ cell tumour of the liver
legend: A liver hilum germ cell tumour centred around the common hepatic/bile duct in a 9-year-old girl. Serum AFP = 4000 µg/L. A mature hepatocellular component (centre) is admixed with an immature epithelial (left) and mesenchymal (right) component.
While there are morphological features of conventional adenocarcinoma in some areas, there is sheet-like growth in other regions.

The tumour shows a mixture of primitive (germ cell tumour–like) elements (A) and conventional adenocarcinoma (B). The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for SALL4 (C) and glypican-3 (D), and there is patchy AFP expression both in areas with conventional adenocarcinoma morphology and in areas with germ cell tumour–like morphology (E).
